name: Liquid surface region
description: Filled region under a smooth wavy edge at a given level; same structure for every level, so it can rise and fall by morphing.

implementation.api: Studio.draw.wave(seed, {width, height, level, phase, amplitude, fill})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test tests/test-studio-runtime.py and frame review of projects/masala-chai-recipe (landscape, portrait, square) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
